hypothesis: Heterogeneous past-only BTC regression residual ranking adds net value over raw21d cross-sectional ranking under identical BTC hedge, candidate pool and risk/cost treatment
BTC_role: Market regressor and hedge instrument only, never cross-sectional rank candidate
regression: Exactly84 past completed daily log returns per asset, OLS with intercept on BTC log returns; beta=sum(centeredBTC*centeredAlt)/sum(centeredBTC^2), alpha=meanAlt-beta*meanBTC; no global normalization, future labels or hyperparameters
raw_score: Original21d cumulative price return; top2 +.15 and bottom2 -.15, weekly Monday anchor2024-01-01. Full tie CASH, original stable ordered tie rule
residual_score: Sum over most recent21 daily log residuals r_alt-alpha84-beta84*r_BTC, using current past84 regression; no residual-volatility rescaling
common_mask: All5 assets85 consecutive finite positive completed daily closes and nondegenerate BTC regression variance; same mask both arms. Unavailable clears targets to CASH until next scheduled weekly rank, no outcome mask
holding: Weekly unscaled alt rank positions, daily recalculation of BTC hedge and same30d simple-return covariance risk. No holding-period change or absolute-direction filter
hedge: For each arm BTC raw weight=-sum(beta84_i*alt_raw_weight_i); both retain alt short legs. Apply one scalar to entire5-vector to satisfy30% asset and60% gross before existing10% annual signed covariance downscale, preserving modeled beta neutrality
risk: Shared10,000USDT each independent comparison wallet; aggregate all legs in same wallet, isolated1x, no automatic topup; existing .99 buffer and actual drift/risk reduction. Same target procedure is not guaranteed equal realized risk or riskmatched alpha
causal_diagnostic: 2021-01-01 through2021-12-31, 2020 warmup only; no economic labels queried before allocation gate. Rolling coefficients fit only prior windows, saved with actual fit counts
allocation_gates: >=40 valid mature weekly rank events in2021
>=10 distinct raw/residual weekly alt allocation differences
heterogeneous beta range>1e-8 on changed rank dates
same mask and target caps/covariance bound on all dates
economic_scope_reason: One fixed63-day training episode anchored to Monday/quarter, within already public complete2021 Jan-Nov minute tape. December full mark tape absent; no replacement based on profit or later source windows
economic_gate: Only after all allocation gates, run4 serial wallets (2arms*2funding unit interpretations), no automatic retry or extra windows/configs
economic_continuation_gates: all4 cases complete with charged terminal CASH and independent cash audit
residual netPnL>0 in both funding scales
paired netPnL increment>0 in both scales
conditional joint14day bootstrap increment lower95%>0 in both scales
alt-leg gross price increment>0 in both scales, separately report BTC hedge price increment
each annual realized vol<=12% and minute MDD<=12%
residual/raw realized vol ratio<=1.10; report all realized-risk differences

bootstrap.interval_scope: Conditional descriptive training episode, not selection-corrected/unseen OOS

execution: Reuse exact existing perpetual_directional scheduler, BybitIsolatedAccount, Decimal wallet and ExecutionContractV2; observed Binance1m trade OPEN after1minute+1us delay; prior-minute quote capacity participation .001/max5 attempts; existing asset/gross risk reductions and minute-mark .005 assumed liquidation
cost: Unchanged BASE27 fee5.5bp, halfspread4bp, slip4bp each fill; additional BTC turnover fully charged; terminal last6minutes/max5 capacity attempts, no free closure
funding: All actual retained signed timestamps/rates with actual owned signed quantity and strict previous closed-minute mark; scale1 and.01 are predeclared conditional unit interpretations, no exact charge-mark/publication/venue certification. Stop gaps, never zero-fill owned funding

minute_source.transport: Existing Git objects only, no official provider redownload

stop: Any allocation gate fails => no economic wallets. Any economic gate fails => stop this exact84/21 recipe; no factor/window/unit inversion or HPO. Continue project only with evidence-backed independent work; no repeated old recipes
preserve: Old funding and CPD STOP unchanged, collector2026Mar-Sep lock unopened, noQ3_2026, no missingledger reconstruction, no other branch files
